# Verify who they are.And what’s behind the name.

Authenticate is an identity verification platform that confirms a person is real and who they claim to be, then checks the criminal, driving, employment and education records behind the name. One provider instead of two.

[![Authenticate®](<Base64-Image-Removed>)](https://verify.authenticating.com/onboarding)[Get Started](https://portal.authenticate.com/register?utm_source=homepage&utm_medium=hero_cta)

An animated verification: a government ID is scanned, its details are checked against identity sources and background records, and the result resolves to a confidence rating of 99 with a low risk assessment.

## Integrate in Minutes

![Link Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Verify by Link

Generate a tokenized link to a custom branded workflow. Includes enhanced features like auto-image capture, expert manual review, facial recognition and passive liveness detection.

[See details](https://docs.authenticate.com/reference/user)

![Web SDK Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Web SDK

Embed a React application within the four corners of your application to give users a browser-based, authentication experience without needing to code.

[See details](https://docs.authenticate.com/docs/medalliontm)

![Mobile SDK Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Mobile SDKs

Create mobile native applications for iOS or Android with our mobile SDKs that include active liveness detection for facial recognition and liveness detection.

[See details](https://docs.authenticate.com/docs/android-developer-app)

## ![Medallion™](<Base64-Image-Removed>)Works Worldwide!

We're able to authenticate practically anyone, anywhere. And Medallion™ is easier to use than any other solution.

[Contact Us](https://authenticate.com/#contact) [![Authenticate®](<Base64-Image-Removed>)](https://verify.authenticating.com/onboarding)

### 16,000+Passports & IDs Worldwide

Instant forensic analysis of 16,000+ government IDs from 254 countries and territories in 38 languages.

### Multiple Verification Options

Optional facial recognition, active & or passive liveness detection & optional additional verification methods including knowledge based authentication, financial account ownership verification, or multi-factor authentication.

### $0Setup Fee & No Long Term Contract

Get started with a $100 deposit for utilization credit. Draw down your balance over time and auto-replenish when empty.

### Automate Background Verifications

Include national criminal background, sex offender registry, and global watch list checks as well as education, employment and professional license verification.
